==Is this puzzle dead?==
I am a cryptologist, I have studied stuff like this for a long time, but I have never seen anything like this. I wanted to know if this test is still active and if people are still participating. Please respond ASAP. I have deciphered some of the text, would like to run it by someone.
{{Sign|108.7.153.98}}
:You can visit us in [https://webchat.freenode.net/?channels=#cicadasolvers #cicadasolvers freenode IRC channel] :Solving community is still dozens active and puzzle is not dead until its solved. :Second option to communicate is if you create account on Wikia. But IRC is faster, chat system. -- [[User:Lurker69|Lurker69]]
